tokens: fc56c49f-1st_preview.html (uploaded first draft, :root and body[data-theme] blocks)

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground (the draft's --paper). Everything sits on it; body text is `ink`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the nav ticker, KPI cells (the draft's --panel). Text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-plate
tokens.usage: Figure plates and notebook viewer frames: a half-step between surface and surface-raised, so a chart never floats on the same tone as its card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-plate` (16:1 / 13:1 / 15:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, mono labels on `surface` and `surface-raised` (6.8:1 / 6.2:1 / 6.8:1). Never below 11px.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline borders between panels, table rows, card plates. Decorative only: it is not meant to be read.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Masthead rules, section-head lines and the nav's bottom border: a border that carries meaning (3:1 on every ground).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one hue of each tide: Pacific blue at low tide, burnt terracotta at golden hour, CSULB gold at high tide. Links, active tabs, eyebrows, figure numbers, the primary button fill. As text on `surface`: 7.0:1 / 5.8:1 / 11:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (primary buttons, active tabs).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: A 14% wash of `accent` behind runtime pills and selected rows. Never text.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: CSULB gold, identical in every tide: the ticker dot, the flagship card's edge, the postcard stamp, the highlighted bar in a chart. Fills and marks only; it reads as text in no tide (1.5:1 on surface). Pair with `on-gold`.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on a `gold` fill (the 'The Beach' nav badge): 11:1.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Second accent for a second series in a chart, the wave divider's lower line, a gold pill's border. At high tide it turns sky blue so gold can be the accent. Marks only, never small text.

tokens.name: sea-tint
tokens.usage: Area fills under lines, the bathymetry wash, selected-range brushes at 20–40% opacity. Never text.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Terracotta marks: the 'low-income' dot, a harvest flag, a warning pill's border. As text only at high tide (6.2:1) and golden hour (7.3:1); at low tide it is 3.6:1, so use `signal-text`.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Terracotta as text (a disparity stat, a delta that went the wrong way): 5.6:1 / 7.3:1 / 6.2:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: kelp
tokens.usage: Green for a verified credential, a passing test count, a positive delta. Text on `surface`: 5.6:1 / 7.6:1 / 9.0:1. Always paired with a word or a check glyph, never hue alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element (7:1 / 5.8:1 / 8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop behind the figure-focus and certificate modals.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero name and the resume title. Clamp to 48px on phones. The surname may be italic in `accent`.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles inside a view (deep dive, studio, notebooks). Clamp to 36px on phones.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles. Italic when it names a working paper or a figure.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: The number in a KPI cell or stat tile, in `accent`.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Roman section numerals and the resume's № marks, in `accent`.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Applied statistics turning public microdata into reproducible, browser-native narratives.
styles.usage: The hero bio and a page's standfirst, max 36em.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Volume on the westbound I-94 averages 3,260 vehicles per hour.
styles.usage: Default body copy on every page. Max 42em measure.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: After cleaning and de-duplication, Games dominated iOS.
styles.usage: Card blurbs, resume bullets, modal copy, in `ink-muted` with `ink` strong spans.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 1-Year PUMS, 2023.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, nav links, plate headers, pill text. Never below 10px; the ticker is the only 10px use.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Filenames, credential IDs, dates, footer meta, search input. Mixed case.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code drawers and inline code; on `surface-plate` inside a `rule` border.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills and tags; caption margin.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Plate padding, KPI cell gap, toolbar padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; gap inside a card body.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter, card padding, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones; modal and postcard padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero top padding and gap between hero columns.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding; deep-dive header padding on desktop.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a column of body copy.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the main container; the resume broadsheet is 1040px.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Cards, plates, buttons, the viewer frame: the system is square and editorial.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Pills, badges, the tide switcher's inner buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The tide switcher's outer border and the search field.

tokens.name: radius-pill

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Figure plates, the notebook viewer frame, a hovered project card. The only shadow in the system; everything else is a hairline `rule`.

border.note: Hairlines are the system's main structure.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Inner borders: plate edges, table rows, dashed marginalia.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and viewer frame borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
